meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按预设规则切换助手的工作模式,让它照你设定的方式执行任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让助手用一套固定指令改变自己的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Switch the assistant into a preset work mode so it runs tasks your way
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to change how it works via a fixed set of directives

howto.what: 启用后首行输出「ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!」,转为专家编码代理:登记目标与成功标准、开笔记本、建待办清单,并用 HTTP/终端/浏览器等真实证据验证交付。
howto.when: 当你请求 ultrawork 模式且该指令还不在对话中时触发;它本身即指令,启动时一次性判定 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级。

say.text: 启用 ultrawork 模式,帮我修这个 bug
say.note: 首行输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式实现这个接口,并附真实证据
say.note: 会登记目标、开笔记本,再按标准验证

say.text: 这次重构请全程用 ultrawork 模式
say.note: 跨域重构按 HEAVY 分级执行

howto.what_en: When enabled it prints “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!” first, then acts as an expert coding agent: registers a goal with success criteria, keeps a notepad, builds a todo list, and proves work with real-surface evidence (HTTP, terminal, browser).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you request ultrawork mode and this directive is not already in the conversation; the file itself is the directive, and tier (LIGHT/HEAVY) is decided once at bootstrap.

say_en.text: Turn on ultrawork mode and fix this bug
say_en.note: First line prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to build this endpoint, with real evidence
say_en.note: Registers a goal, keeps a notepad, then verifies

say_en.text: Run this refactor fully in ultrawork mode
say_en.note: Cross-domain refactors run at HEAVY tier
